measurement.rectMethod: Measured alpha > 10 subject bounds plus 2 px padding; not uniform grid cuts.
measurement.anchorMethod: y = bottom edge of alpha > 127 subject. x = average x of the top 5 rows of the body back ridge in a visually selected torso region, rounded. This projects a stable torso landmark to the ground rather than following a moving paw.

frames.observation: 站立睁眼；四足位置固定。
同姿势闭眼弯弧，脸/身体/脚底稳定。
低头、闭嘴；身体站位保持，头部下探。
同低头姿势，嘴巴微张、眼睛弯弧；身体稳定。

inspection.character: Consistent warm orange tabby with cream muzzle/chest/paws and the same striped tail.
inspection.idleBlink: Pass: two matched standing poses with a clear open-eye / closed-eye change.
inspection.eat: Pass: two matched head-down poses with closed-mouth / tiny open-mouth nibble. This is a short stylized nibble loop, not a full chew animation.
inspection.anchorStability: Back ridge ground projections differ by about 2 px within pairs; ground y is stable after anchoring.
inspection.scaleCompatibility: Body back-to-ground height is 254–260 source px; walk-v2 is 259–266 source px. Difference is under 5%, so a shared worldScale 0.07 is reasonable. Do not use walk-v1 source scale without separate scale adaptation.
inspection.limitations: No actual food object or long eating sequence is included. Transition from upright idle to head-down eat is a pose change; gameplay may add a brief hold, but must not call translation a new animation frame.

checks: Both states load with correct source rectangles and real transparency on checkerboard.
Idle eye shapes clearly switch while torso, feet and tail stay stable.
Eating closed/open mouth states are distinct; torso and sole baseline remain stable.
Source frame rectangles do not clip nose/tail/paws.
Preview asymmetric-anchor layout was fixed; full subject fits both enlarged stage and static cards.
